title: BANXE process_ref (Business Process Repository reference)
description: Executable contract for the `process_ref` resolvable handle that names a canonical, versioned business-process definition in the S13-00 Business Process Repository (ADR-048). A process_ref is the stable {process_id, version} handle an L1 intent resolves to BEFORE any consequential L2 action (ADR-048 D3), and the shared key that ADR-046 decision lineage and ADR-047 cost attribution carry to attribute a decision / its cost to a specific governed process version (ADR-048 D5). This schema fixes the FORMAT that S3 / banxe-business-processes (the canonized CarmiBanxe/banxe-business-processes ArchiMate 3.2 repo) MUST produce so a process_ref always resolves to exactly one canonical process version. An intent that resolves to NO process is a governance event, not improvisation (ADR-048 D3 / CLAUDE.md §11). R-SEC: a process_ref is a non-sensitive identifier pair — it MUST NOT embed secrets or PII.

process_id.description: Stable, unique identifier of the canonical business-process definition in the S13-00 repository (ADR-048 D1/D3). Names the process (e.g. a KYC-onboarding / payment-execution / safeguarding-reconciliation process) independent of version. Source of truth: CarmiBanxe/banxe-business-processes (ArchiMate 3.2).

version.description: Specific, resolvable version of the process definition (ADR-048 D4 — every definition is versioned; a process_ref always names ONE version). Older versions remain resolvable so a past decision's lineage (ADR-046) can be replayed against the version that actually ran. Concrete versioning grammar (semver vs revision tag) is S3/config work; this schema requires a non-empty stable token.
